title: The Snow Hare
text: A white hare sits in the snow ahead and does not run. It is watching the party with a man's eyes, brown and sad and knowing. When you stop, it stops. When you move, it hops a little way ahead.

options.label: Follow the hare with a man's eyes. It seems to want you to.

outcomes.text: To a hidden cave, warm and dry, and the hare gone.
To a hunter's snare, and the hare watching from the drift.

options.label: The wisest speaks to it, to learn what it once was.

outcomes.text: A shapeshifter, sad and tired, who warns you of what is ahead.

options.label: Hunt the hare. Meat is meat, whatever its eyes.
